risks.title: Volatility of oil and natural gas prices
risks.summary: Fluctuations in oil and natural gas prices directly affect the profitability of the companies in which FEC Resources invests. A prolonged decline in prices could render discovered reserves uneconomic and reduce cash flows from investments.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned early in Item 1A as a key factor affecting investee companies. Direct language ("will be important"). Recurring structural risk for the E&P sector. High weight: total dependence of success on profitable discoveries.

risks.title: Uncertainties regarding proved reserves and production timeline
risks.summary: Estimates of proved reserves and projected production rates of investee companies involve significant uncertainties. Downward revisions of reserves or development delays could undermine expected returns.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed as a major risk in Item 1A. Uncertainty language ("uncertainties in estimates"). Direct impact on investment valuation and financial planning. Critical for an E&P investment company.

risks.title: Limited ability to market reserves (transportation infrastructure)
risks.summary: Investee companies may face marketing constraints due to lack of transportation capacity (pipelines, processing facilities). For example, new gas wells may be shut in due to lack of market access until pipeline expansion occurs.
risks.score_rationale: Specific risk mentioned: "potential constraints on the ability to market reserves due to limited transportation space". Moderate but concrete language. Affects realization of indirect investment projects.

risks.title: Operational risks and hazards of oil and gas exploration and production
risks.summary: Exploration and production activities carry high operational risks: dry wells, accidents, weather conditions, title issues, operator financial instability. Few explored properties become profitable.
risks.score_rationale: Listed as "operating hazards attendant to the oil and natural gas business". Direct language. Covers drilling, accidents, operational shutdowns. High potential impact on invested assets and cash flows.

risks.title: Dependence on investee companies' ability to acquire new reserves
risks.summary: FEC's success depends on the ability of investee companies to discover or acquire new reserves to replace those being produced. Lack of drilling or acquisition success would lead to asset and revenue decline.
risks.score_rationale: Key risk: "ability of companies we invest in to find and acquire additional reserves". Language of critical importance. Without reserve replacement, assets decline. Directly linked to FEC's investment model.

risks.title: Geopolitical and regulatory risks (notably Philippines-China dispute)
risks.summary: Investee companies operate in areas exposed to political and economic uncertainties, notably the territorial dispute between the Philippines and China. Changes in energy policies, currency controls, and exchange rate fluctuations could affect operations.
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned: "territorial dispute between the Republic of Philippines and the People's Republic of China". Concrete language. Affects regional operations. Energy regulation and currency control risk.

risks.title: Environmental risks and adverse regulatory decisions
risks.summary: Investee companies face environmental risks and adverse regulatory or legal decisions under environmental laws. Compliance costs and production restrictions could reduce project profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned twice: "environmental risks" and "adverse regulatory or legal decisions under environmental laws". Moderate but repeated language. Increasing impact of environmental regulation on E&P operations.

risks.title: Dilution of control and inability to fund capital calls (FEL)
risks.summary: FEC Resources cannot guarantee its ability to fund future capital calls from Forum Energy Limited (FEL) to maintain its 6.8% stake. Failure to participate would result in dilution of ownership and loss of control.
risks.score_rationale: Specific and repeated risk: "no guarantee that we can provide necessary funds and our interest in FEL may be diluted". High uncertainty language. Direct impact on 6.8% stake in FEL. Critical dependence on PXP.
